`sphere.brep.json` was emitted directly by
Engine's `DisplaySnapshot::capture_live_json` from an OpenNURBS sphere of radius
0.002 meters, with scale 1.0. It exercises NURBS conversion, periodic surfaces
and remapped UV trims. Numeric JSON is retained verbatim.

Producer: Engine `55ae41f05`,
`cpp/engine/scene/model/brep/display-snapshot-json.h`.
